fact: Law No. 2010/021 of 21 December 2010, adopted by the National Assembly and promulgated by the President, states that it governs electronic commerce in Cameroon and defines electronic signatures, certificates and certification authorities (capture covers Titles I and the start of II only).
system: Loi n°2010/021 régissant le commerce électronique au Cameroun

fact: Law no. 2010/021 of 21 December 2010 governing electronic commerce in Cameroon exists as a made law, and the Prime Minister's decree of 15 June 2011 fixes its application rules.
Decree no. 2011/1521/PM of 15 June 2011 fixes the modalities of application of law no. 2010/021 on electronic commerce, defining the scope of e-commerce activity.
At a CENADI workshop, Professor Jean Louis Fendji listed Cameroon's e-commerce law among the local texts that frame aspects of data protection.
